import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import subprocess, sys
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# Installer
def install(pkg): subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', pkg])

# Imports
try:
    import seaborn as sns
except ImportError:
    install('seaborn'); import seaborn as sns
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy'); import gseapy as gp

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Subset clinical: lymph nodes vs skin
groups = (clin[clin['primary_site'].isin(['Lymph nodes','Skin'])]
          .loc[:, ['bcr_patient_barcode','primary_site','age_at_diagnosis','gender']]
          .rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode':'patient_id'})
          .set_index('patient_id'))

# 3. TMB per patient
tmb = mut.groupby('patient_id').size().rename('TMB')
grp = groups.join(tmb).fillna(0)
grp['TMB'] = grp['TMB'].astype(int)

# 4. Prepare expression: map to patient IDs
expr_sub = expr.rename(columns={c: c[:12] for c in expr.columns})
common = grp.index.intersection(expr_sub.columns)
print(f"Patients in groups: {len(grp)}, with expr data: {len(common)}")
grp = grp.loc[common]
expr_sub = expr_sub[common]

# 5. Compare TMB
grp['primary_site'] = grp['primary_site'].astype('category')
ln = grp.loc[grp['primary_site']=='Lymph nodes','TMB']
sk = grp.loc[grp['primary_site']=='Skin','TMB']
stat, pval = mannwhitneyu(ln, sk, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Mann-Whitney U test: U={stat:.1f}, p={pval:.3e}")
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.boxplot(x='primary_site', y='TMB', data=grp.reset_index())
plt.title(f"TMB by site (p={pval:.2e})"); plt.xlabel('Primary Site'); plt.ylabel('TMB')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 6. Differential expression
# Design matrix
design = grp[['primary_site','age_at_diagnosis','gender']].copy()
design['group'] = (design['primary_site']=='Lymph nodes').astype(int)
design['gender_female'] = (design['gender']=='FEMALE').astype(int)
design = design[['group','age_at_diagnosis','gender_female']]
# Align order with expr_sub columns
design = design.loc[expr_sub.columns]
design_matrix = sm.add_constant(design)
print(f"Design matrix shape: {design_matrix.shape}, Expr data shape: {expr_sub.shape}")

# Fit OLS per gene
gene_list = expr_sub.index.tolist()
results = []
X = design_matrix.values
for gene in gene_list:
    y = expr_sub.loc[gene].values
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    results.append((gene, model.params[1], model.pvalues[1]))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['gene','logFC','pval'])
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pval'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
de_genes = res_df[res_df['FDR']<0.05].sort_values('FDR')
print(f"DE genes (FDR<0.05): {len(de_genes)}")
print(de_genes.head(10))

# Volcano plot
res_df['negLogP'] = -np.log10(res_df['pval']+1e-300)
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sns.scatterplot(x='logFC', y='negLogP', data=res_df,
                hue=res_df['FDR']<0.05, palette={True:'red',False:'grey'}, legend=False)
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), ls='--', c='blue')
plt.xlabel('Log2FC (Lymph vs Skin)'); plt.ylabel('-Log10 p'); plt.title('Volcano Plot')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 7. GSEA on upregulated genes
up = de_genes[de_genes['logFC']>0]['gene'].tolist()
enr = gp.enrichr(gene_list=up, gene_sets=['KEGG_2016'], organism='Human', outdir=None)
print("Top enriched pathways:")
print(enr.results[['Term','Adjusted P-value','Overlap']].head(10))
